chunks: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Umar ibn Salim, from Yahya ibn Ali, from al-Rabi', from Abi Lubaid, who said:
The Abyssinians will change/demolish the House (Kaaba), breaking it; and the Stone (Black Stone) will be taken and fixed in the Mosque of Kufa.

key_terms.الۡبَيۡتَ: The House (referring to the Kaaba in Mecca)
key_terms.الۡحِجَرُ: The Stone (referring to the Black Stone, al-Hajar al-Aswad)

ai.seo_question: What are the signs of the Abyssinians demolishing the Kaaba and the Black Stone being moved to Kufa?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the 'Suffyani' era signs, specifically the Abyssinian invasion (*Khuruj al-Habasha*) that leads to the desecration of the Kaaba. The subsequent relocation of the Black Stone to Kufa symbolizes the shift of spiritual authority and the establishment of the Imam’s base, serving as a pivotal precursor to the global justice of Imam Mahdi (a.s.).
